meaning:
δια-γίνομαι
(Ion. and late Gk. for διαγίγν-), [in LXX, 2Ma.11:26 * ;]
1. to go through, to pass, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., to live.
2. Of time, to intervene, elapse: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, Act.25:13; ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, ib. 27:9; τ. σαβάτου, Mrk.16:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea, and greeted Festus.
